source: CLAUDE.md §3.4(e); CONTRACTS.md §1.5 and R5.1. The Tier 3 stop-screen text is table-driven (R5.1, replacing the CLAUDE.md wording after the 2026-10-11 playtest) and is the only participant-facing text the system shows in an urgent situation.
rationale: A four-step ladder keeps triage decisions deterministic and auditable: the base tier comes from the highest provisional grade, red flags set a floor, and vitals corroboration can add at most one step (capped at 3). Tier 3 stops the kiosk, shows a fixed pre-approved screen and pages the on-call role through the mock pager. No tier text contains medical advice beyond the fixed stop screen.

tiers.name: Log
tiers.action: Record goes to the coordinator queue. No notification.

tiers.name: Nurse call today
tiers.action: Research nurse calls the participant today.

tiers.name: Urgent
tiers.action: Kiosk stops the check-in and shows the fixed stop screen; the on-call role is paged (mock pager).
triggers: severe or very severe shortness of breath
trouble breathing or chest pain right now (urgent_now = yes)
a phrase in the comment box the scanner flags as an emergency or urgent warning sign
Tier 2 plus a vitals corroboration rule
tiers.stop_screen_text: If you are having trouble breathing or chest pain right now, call 911 now. Your answers were saved. A member of the study team has been alerted and will contact you today.
